description: The public leaderboard: every ranked site by the score of its latest read, places shared on a tie, or the board of one crowd: a line of work with "in", a state, a city in that state, a size, or any of them together, each place counted as a site's report counts it. Each with its stages, pages read and its score the read before. With "record", one of the records instead: the fastest to answer, the most improved, the best on each stage, the best at answering first, or the biggest read in full, each with what it was counted over. A site whose owner keeps it unnamed goes by its code. Drafts and sites closed to crawlers are not ranked.

city.description: A city in that state, such as Dallas, for the board of the sites there. Needs state.

in.description: A line of work, such as trades, for its own board. Left out, every site.

offset.description: How many to skip, for the next part of a long list.

record.description: One record in place of the places.

size.description: Sites of about one size, by the pages a read took of them.

state.description: A US state by its two letters, such as MO, for the board of the sites there.

name: mttr_leaderboard
title: Get the leaderboard
